correctness.rationale: The published exact series is rederived algebraically into a strictly monotone derivative-sign function giving unique global optima. The q-gamma product ratio and its limit are checked against NIST DLMF 5.18.4/5.18.10. Factorwise coefficient limits plus global power-series majorants prove locally uniform limiting objectives and derivatives. Positive first and fourth-degree terms bound minimizers away from both zero and infinity; their limits yield rigorous convergence to the unique OU minimizer. An independently evaluated OU Gaussian hitting-time integral matches the explicit limit series. The included script passed 33 numerical consistency assertions; decimals are not certified enclosures.

originality.rationale: Biroli et al. (arXiv:2406.08387v1, full-text Sec. III.1) give the exact finite-a MFPT and plot an apparently unique optimum, but not its rigorous all-parameter uniqueness and especially not the joint weak-contraction optimized limit and its universal constants. Tal-Friedman et al. give only a stationary spatial Gaussian limit; Pierce gives the first-passage equation, not the optimized result. Related prior findings and indexed literature searches did not provide a covering claim. Residual priority uncertainty is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed later paper or broader singular-perturbation result could contain the same optimized OU limit or constants.
The original exact MFPT formula already implicitly contains the whole result; the rigorous optimized asymptotic is the claimed mathematical extension, not a new MFPT identity.

value.rationale: The joint regime of vanishing individual reset effect and diverging reset frequency is a natural, physically measurable optimization problem. The exact coefficient 1.64065482984 determines the unique rate scale needed to preserve efficient search, while the 1.99986485199 limit gives a finite universal optimal search time; the global-minimizer convergence proof is necessary because local process convergence alone does not establish optimal control convergence. The work is a substantive singular-limit classification rather than a fixed-parameter algebraic restatement.
